queries: DayDreamer world models physical robot learning 2022

sources_considered.why: Dated primary research describing physical robots learning directly from interaction before the post.
Read the proceedings version, but used the explicitly dated 2022 preprint to establish pre-post availability.

evidence_items.explanation: By this date, the authors had publicly reported a world-model learning approach demonstrated on four physical robots, including locomotion, manipulation, and navigation. Learning from direct interaction and from scratch provides a counterexample under the stated reading; the inference concerns these demonstrated tasks, not unrestricted intelligence.

unresolved_gaps: The source does not demonstrate a broadly general replacement for large language models.
The speaker supplied no capability threshold that would distinguish useful task learning from sufficiently general effectiveness.
